$comment: Hand-verified by reading the source — never generated by an analyzer, since a key
derived from the thing it grades proves nothing.
Scope is deliberately narrow: routes only. Ground truth is written when the stage
that consumes it exists, not in advance. Completeness accounting (every file
dispositioned, every candidate resolved) is tested by internal invariants and needs

notRoutes.$comment: Registered like routes but are 404/405 fallbacks. Counting them inflates recall.

hardCases.$comment: Why this root is worth grading against — each of these breaks a naive scan.
hardCases.groupPrefix: 12 of 15 routes inherit /oauth from engine.Group; the literal argument alone gives the wrong path
hardCases.wrappedHandler: 6 handlers sit inside e.CatchError(...), so the symbol is an argument, not the callee
hardCases.wildcardParam: /swagger/*any uses a wildcard rather than a named parameter
hardCases.anyMethod: /health is registered with engine.Any and has no single method
hardCases.inlineClosure: /health's handler is an anonymous closure with no name
hardCases.splitRegistration: registration spans handler.go and main.go; a single-file scan misses /health
